title: vehicle_params
description: Single source of physical truth for the vehicle (claude-docs/06-vehicle-params.md). Every leaf field carries a machine-readable 'units' annotation and, where a sign convention applies, a 'sign_convention' annotation. Consumers (tools/gen_params.py and everything downstream) must validate against this schema and refuse to start on a mismatch (rule 06-2).

pacejka_params.description: Magic Formula tire model coefficients. Null until a Phase 3 sysid fit exists (claude-docs/06-vehicle-params.md, claude-docs/07-sim-and-sysid.md).

pwm_us.units: microseconds (raw PWM pulse width; non-SI driver-boundary value, see CLAUDE.md invariant 4)
pwm_us.description: Raw servo PWM pulse width for this calibration point.

angle_rad.description: Measured road-wheel angle produced by pwm_us.

mount_x_m.sign_convention: REP-103 base_link frame: x forward positive
mount_x_m.description: Sensor mounting offset from base_link origin along x. Null until Phase 2 ingest-board measurement (claude-docs/06-vehicle-params.md, roadmap 2.1/2.2).

mount_y_m.sign_convention: REP-103 base_link frame: y left positive
mount_y_m.description: Sensor mounting offset from base_link origin along y. Null until Phase 2 measurement.

mount_z_m.sign_convention: REP-103 base_link frame: z up positive
mount_z_m.description: Sensor mounting offset from base_link origin along z. Null until Phase 2 measurement.

mount_yaw_rad.description: Sensor mounting yaw relative to base_link. Null until Phase 2 measurement.

timestamp_offset_s.description: Fixed timestamp offset from the ingest board's shared clock, per the sync design doc (roadmap 2.2). Null until that doc exists.

mass_kg.description: Total vehicle mass, including onboard compute.

wheelbase_m.description: Distance between front and rear axles (cg_to_front_axle_m + cg_to_rear_axle_m).

cg_to_front_axle_m.sign_convention: distance measured forward from CG along +x (REP-103)
cg_to_front_axle_m.description: Longitudinal distance from centre of gravity to the front axle.

cg_to_rear_axle_m.sign_convention: distance measured aft from CG along -x (REP-103)
cg_to_rear_axle_m.description: Longitudinal distance from centre of gravity to the rear axle.

track_width_m.description: Distance between left/right wheel contact patches. Not modeled by the f1tenth_gym single-track model; null until Phase 1 chassis measurement.

cg_height_m.sign_convention: REP-103: z up positive, measured from ground plane
cg_height_m.description: Height of the centre of gravity above the ground plane.

yaw_inertia_kg_m2.description: Yaw moment of inertia about the vertical axis through the CG.

linear_cornering_stiffness_front_n_per_r.description: Linear tire model cornering stiffness, front axle. Placeholder pending a full Pacejka fit (see pacejka_front).

linear_cornering_stiffness_rear_n_per_ra.description: Linear tire model cornering stiffness, rear axle. Placeholder pending a full Pacejka fit (see pacejka_rear).

nominal_radius_m.description: Nominal wheel/tire radius. MEASURED and drift-tracked (tires wear); null until measured, see sysid/drift/.

compound_id.description: Tire compound identifier. Placeholder string until Phase 3 tire spec is recorded.

surface_id.description: Running-surface identifier. Placeholder string until the venue surface is surveyed.

kinematic_dynamic_switch_velocity_mps.description: Speed below which the kinematic (rather than dynamic single-track) model is used, per the f1tenth_gym vehicle model.

gear_ratio.description: Motor-to-wheel gear ratio. Null until Phase 1 drivetrain assembly.

pole_pairs.description: Motor pole pair count, used for ERPM <-> wheel speed conversion. Null until the motor is specified/measured.

motor_kv_rad_per_s_per_v.description: Motor velocity constant. Manufacturer datasheets quote Kv in RPM/V; it must be converted to SI at the driver boundary before being written here (CLAUDE.md invariant 4). Null until measured.

current_limit_a.description: Drive current limit, mirrors the VESC layer-2 config. Null until that config exists.

brake_current_limit_a.description: Brake current limit, mirrors the VESC layer-2 config. Null until that config exists.

min_rate_rad_per_s.description: Minimum (fastest rightward) steering rate the servo can achieve.

max_rate_rad_per_s.description: Maximum (fastest leftward) steering rate the servo can achieve.

time_constant_s.description: First-order servo response time constant. Null until measured (Phase 2/3).

pwm_to_angle_table.description: Calibrated servo PWM <-> road-wheel-angle table (claude-docs/06-vehicle-params.md). Null (not assumed linear) until measured.

pwm_min_us.units: microseconds (raw PWM pulse width; non-SI driver-boundary value, see CLAUDE.md invariant 4)
pwm_min_us.description: Minimum valid steering-servo PWM pulse width, used by firmware/safety_mux (roadmap task 1.3) to reject an out-of-range/glitched Jetson-side steering signal before passing it to the servo. Added for milestone 4 (hardware-arrival prep); null until Phase 1 bench measurement against the actual servo/receiver pair.

pwm_max_us.units: microseconds (raw PWM pulse width; non-SI driver-boundary value, see CLAUDE.md invariant 4)
pwm_max_us.description: Maximum valid steering-servo PWM pulse width, used by firmware/safety_mux (roadmap task 1.3) to reject an out-of-range/glitched Jetson-side steering signal before passing it to the servo. Added for milestone 4 (hardware-arrival prep); null until Phase 1 bench measurement against the actual servo/receiver pair.

pwm_neutral_us.units: microseconds (raw PWM pulse width; non-SI driver-boundary value, see CLAUDE.md invariant 4)
pwm_neutral_us.description: Steering-servo PWM pulse width firmware/safety_mux (roadmap task 1.3) outputs when cutting (kill switch, watchdog timeout, or invalid input) -- centered/straight, not merely 'no signal', so the failsafe does not depend on the servo's own signal-loss behavior. Added for milestone 4; null until Phase 1 bench measurement.

command_to_torque_delay_s.description: Measured command-to-torque transport delay. Null until measured.

throttle_time_constant_s.description: First-order throttle response time constant. Null until measured.

throttle_pwm_min_us.units: microseconds (raw PWM pulse width; non-SI driver-boundary value, see CLAUDE.md invariant 4)
throttle_pwm_min_us.description: Minimum valid ESC/throttle PWM pulse width, used by firmware/safety_mux (roadmap task 1.3) to reject an out-of-range/glitched Jetson-side throttle signal before passing it to the ESC. Added for milestone 4 (hardware-arrival prep); null until Phase 1 bench measurement against the actual ESC/receiver pair.

throttle_pwm_max_us.units: microseconds (raw PWM pulse width; non-SI driver-boundary value, see CLAUDE.md invariant 4)
throttle_pwm_max_us.description: Maximum valid ESC/throttle PWM pulse width, used by firmware/safety_mux (roadmap task 1.3) to reject an out-of-range/glitched Jetson-side throttle signal before passing it to the ESC. Added for milestone 4 (hardware-arrival prep); null until Phase 1 bench measurement against the actual ESC/receiver pair.

throttle_pwm_neutral_us.units: microseconds (raw PWM pulse width; non-SI driver-boundary value, see CLAUDE.md invariant 4)
throttle_pwm_neutral_us.description: ESC PWM pulse width firmware/safety_mux (roadmap task 1.3) outputs when cutting (kill switch, watchdog timeout, or invalid input) -- the ESC's documented zero-throttle/brake-neutral value, not merely 'no signal'. Added for milestone 4; null until Phase 1 bench measurement.

imu.description: IMU is designed to mount at the CG (claude-docs/06-vehicle-params.md); exact offsets are null until Phase 2 ingest-board measurement.

lidar.description: LiDAR mounting pose; null until Phase 2 (roadmap 2.3).

global_speed_cap_mps.description: Global forward speed cap enforced by layers 3-4. Sourced here from the f1tenth_gym dynamic-model validity bound (v_max), NOT a validated on-vehicle safety limit; must be re-set conservatively before Phase 1 bench testing.

min_velocity_mps.description: Reverse speed cap enforced by layers 3-4.

ttc_warning_s.description: Time-to-collision warning threshold. Null until tuned.

ttc_brake_s.description: Time-to-collision hard-brake threshold. Null until tuned.

envelope_fraction_speed.description: Envelope fraction of the speed cap the residual policy may command. Null until tuned (claude-docs/08-learning.md).

envelope_fraction_lateral_accel.description: Envelope fraction of the friction-limited lateral acceleration the residual policy may command. Null until tuned (claude-docs/08-learning.md).

mux_watchdog_timeout_s.description: Layer-1 safety mux (firmware/safety_mux, roadmap task 1.3, claude-docs/05-safety.md): how long the mux MCU waits with no Jetson-side heartbeat before cutting drive/steering PWM and asserting the power cutoff. This is a LAYER-1 constant read only by that firmware's C binding -- it must never be confused with racer_safety's layer-3 /drive_raw watchdog (watchdog_missed_cycles * control_period_s in gate_logic.hpp), which is a separate mechanism on a separate MCU by design. Added for milestone 4 (hardware-arrival prep); null until Phase 1 bench tuning.

mux_kill_switch_threshold_us.units: microseconds (raw PWM pulse width; non-SI driver-boundary value, see CLAUDE.md invariant 4)
mux_kill_switch_threshold_us.description: Layer-1 safety mux (firmware/safety_mux, roadmap task 1.3): PWM pulse width read from the RC receiver's kill-switch channel at or above which the switch reads as ARMED (drive enabled); below this, or outside the receiver's valid PWM range, reads as KILL (fail-safe default). Added for milestone 4; null until the RC receiver/transmitter pair is bench-measured.

schema_version.description: Semver of this params file's schema. Any change bumps this; consumers refuse on a major mismatch (claude-docs/06-vehicle-params.md rule 5).

sysid_session_id.description: The sysid/fitting/ session id that produced these fitted values, or a clearly-provisional placeholder such as 'none-preliminary' when no on-vehicle fit exists yet.

fit_date.description: Date this params file's values were fitted or, for a preliminary file, the date it was assembled from its cited provenance.
